title: Guy Rolls Up To Save His Girlfriend From Police, Doesn’t End Well
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On August 4, 2022, an officer was on patrol when he observed a female that had pending charges in La Crosse, WI. While the officer waited for backup, the female’s boyfriend arrived and believed she was free to go. Police advised her she was under arrest for the pending charges with which she disagreed. While attempting to take her into custody, her boyfriend continuously interfered with police and ended up getting himself a ride to the county jail too.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
